name: grupo-de-estudos-backend
description: Backend Firebase completo para plataforma privada de estudos competitivos 'Grupo de Estudos'

scripts.seed:homolog: node -e "process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID='grupo-de-estudos-homologacao'; require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix functions run seed', {stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env})"
scripts.fix-permissions:homolog: node -e "process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID='grupo-de-estudos-homologacao'; require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix functions run fix-permissions', {stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env})"
scripts.deploy:homolog: npm run build:web:homolog && firebase deploy -P homologacao
scripts.deploy:homolog:hosting: npm run build:web:homolog && firebase deploy --only hosting -P homologacao
scripts.deploy:prod: npm --prefix web run build && firebase deploy -P production
scripts.deploy:prod:hosting: npm --prefix web run build && firebase deploy --only hosting -P production
